run_check_dummies: run the check_dummies script to verify dummy files are up to date with the main init
run_check_dummies_fix: run the check_dummies script with fix_and_overwrite to update stale dummy files automatically
create_dummy_object: create a dummy class function or constant stub for a given name and backend
create_dummy_files: create the full content of dummy object files from backend-specific objects parsed from init
read_init: read the diffusers init file and extract backend-specific objects grouped by availability checks
